remarks: Investor opportunity at 88 E 2nd Street in Dunkirk. This vacant two unit property with a newer roof is ready for someone with the vision to bring it back to life. Tax records indicate a total of 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, although the current layout and all property details should be independently verified by the buyer. With a low entry price and potential for renovation, rental income, or resale, this could be an interesting addition to an investment portfolio. This property is being offered as part of a package that also includes 92 E 2nd Street, a former bar and restaurant, along with the additional vacant lot identified as Parcel ID No. 060300-79.11-7-47. All three parcels are intended to be sold together as one package. See MLS #B1705022 for the 92 E 2nd Street listing. Property is being sold strictly as is, where is. Seller and listing agents make no representations regarding the condition, layout, utilities, systems, code compliance, permits, violations, or required repairs. Buyer to perform all desired inspections, investigations, municipal searches, and due diligence prior to purchase.
